lead.hed: Law & Liberty: 25 years after 9/11, remember the strength that followed
lead.insight: Law & Liberty, Friday: an anniversary essay says Americans may again need the civic strength found after Sept. 11. Commentary on memory and resolve, not a new statute.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Tajh Payne · DVIDS 9615140 · Public domain · Sailors on the flight deck of USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN 78) in the Mediterranean, April 12, 2026.

political.hed: Heritage: restrict U.S. reproductive tourism, not just birth tourism
political.insight: Heritage Foundation, Friday: after the birthright-citizenship ruling, the essay argues Congress should restrict foreign use of American surrogacy, not only birth-tourism bans. Commentary, not a signed bill.

political.hed: Defense News: Saudi crown prince sought U.S. help against Houthis
political.insight: Defense News, Friday: sources said Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman asked President Trump on Thursday for help against Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis. Attribution is to those sources, not a public readout.

political.hed: USNI: China shifts posture at Scarborough Shoal
political.insight: USNI News, Friday: reporting from Manila says China’s posture at Scarborough Shoal is shifting to better counter Philippine forces at the disputed South China Sea hotspot.

tech.hed: Defense News: Pentagon seeks AI to sort space and missile threats
tech.insight: Defense News, Friday: the Pentagon is soliciting AI software to turn fragmented sensor data into a continuously updated picture of space and missile threats. Solicitation, not a fielded system.

tech.hed: Defense News: Poland says it will build its own Starlink-like system
tech.insight: Defense News, Friday: Prime Minister Donald Tusk said Warsaw will develop a national satellite-communications system in the Starlink mold. Announcement, not a launch.

culture.hed: WORLD: American culture’s favorite whipping boy
culture.insight: WORLD News Group, Friday: a culture essay on the target American public life keeps flogging. Opinion, not a poll.
Law & Liberty, Friday: an anniversary essay asks whether Osama bin Laden finally won American hearts and minds. Argument essay, not a survey.
